caption: A pyramid of empty soda cans at a carnival booth is hit by a tennis ball, and the cans fly off and fall to the counter.

sa.check: A pyramid of empty soda cans stands on a booth counter.
A tennis ball hits the pyramid.
The cans are stacked as a pyramid.
The hit comes first, then the flying cans, then the fall.

pc.expect: Struck cans fly away from the ball, and cans above them lose their support and drop.
pc.fail: Cans fly toward the thrower; or all the cans move as one block; or cans on the far side move while the struck ones stay.

pc.expect: Cans come down to the counter or the floor and stay there.
pc.fail: A can hangs in the air; or rises; or lands and re-stacks.

pc.expect: Cans move only after being hit or losing support.
pc.fail: Cans topple before the ball arrives; or a landed can slides off untouched; or a can jumps from the base while the top stays.

pc.expect: Empty cans are light and dent easily; they clatter and roll rather than shatter.
pc.fail: A can shatters; or squashes flat and re-inflates; or the ball dents deeply and stays dented.

pc.expect: The cans keep their number and the ball stays one ball.
pc.fail: Cans vanish or multiply; or a can passes through another; or the ball vanishes at the hit.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The cans' labels, the counter and the booth stay the same.
pc.fail: A can changes label or colour; or the counter changes between frames; or the booth rearranges.
